summary: d2 upgraded from 0.8.2 to 0.9.0. Two things in it could move a number. A callout's note is no longer measured in a browser at all, so a document whose diagrams carry notes but no legend starts no browser for annotation widths. And a sequence diagram's rows compact again: the new version's callout markup was being read as a message row, which made the pass bail out and left every annotated sequence at d2's own spacing. The machine also picked up a node patch release between the two baselines, which nobody here asked for and which any remaining second belongs to as much as to this change.
why: The note's width now comes from d2's own measurement scaled by the type ratio — it measures the words in the font it embeds with the figure, and an advance width scales with the size — where it used to come from a browser laying the same words out in the page's font. Row compaction recognises a callout by the markdown block d2 wraps a note's words in, rather than by the element that block happened to be made of.
